text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Arima Kinen. Though Kitasan Black was a nobody at first, she now shines as the third most popular Umamusume by fan vote, thus qualifying her for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Standing at number one of the fan polls is Gold Ship. It's time to face the Unsinkable Battleship!
